metadata.title: Bookmark Scout - Modern Browser Bookmark Manager
metadata.description: A browser extension to search, organize, clean up, import/export, and save bookmarks with opt-in AI tools.

hero.title: Bookmark Scout
hero.description: A browser extension to search, organize, clean up, import/export, and save bookmarks. Powered by opt-in AI tools with multi-provider support.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to manage your bookmarks efficiently

aiRecommendations.title: Opt-in AI Tools
aiRecommendations.description: Folder suggestions, tags, summaries, and reorganization plans from the provider you choose: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, Mistral AI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Off by default.

instantSearch.description: Find bookmarks instantly with debounced search and folder filtering

darkMode.description: Follow your system theme or choose light or dark

maintenanceTools.title: Maintenance Tools
maintenanceTools.description: Find duplicates, clean tracking URLs, scan dead links and review repairs, fetch titles, flag privacy-sensitive URLs, and view statistics

importExport.title: Import/Export
importExport.description: Export HTML, JSON, Markdown, or CSV, and preview HTML or JSON imports before anything is written

savedSearches.title: Saved Searches

keyboardShortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts

featuresPage.title: Features
featuresPage.subtitle: Discover everything Bookmark Scout has to offer

instantSearch.title: Instant Search
instantSearch.description: Quickly find any bookmark with our lightning-fast search. Features debounced input for performance and folder filtering to narrow down results.

dragAndDrop.title: Drag & Drop Organization
dragAndDrop.description: Reorganize your bookmarks with intuitive drag-and-drop. Move bookmarks between folders or reorder within a folder with ease.

quickAdd.title: Quick Add
quickAdd.description: Save the current tab to any folder with just one click. No more navigating through nested menus - just pick a folder and done!

sidePanel.title: Side Panel
sidePanel.description: Access your bookmarks from the Chrome or Edge side panel without leaving your current page. Perfect for research and reference work.

bookmarksManager.title: Full Bookmarks Manager
bookmarksManager.description: Replace Chrome's default bookmarks page with a custom manager that includes a folder tree, breadcrumbs, a table-based bookmark view, and a right-side tools panel.

savedSearches.title: Saved Searches
savedSearches.description: Save the manager's filters, sort, and folder scope as named smart views. Only the query is stored, on this device, so results always reflect your current bookmarks.

optionsPage.title: Options Page
optionsPage.description: Configure appearance, search, behavior, AI providers, AI tools, maintenance tools, metadata, security, analytics, data, and context-menu behavior.

darkMode.title: Light & Dark Themes
darkMode.description: Choose light or dark, or follow your system theme. Carefully chosen colors keep text readable in both.

expandCollapse.title: Expand/Collapse All
expandCollapse.description: Quickly expand or collapse all nested folders with a single click. Great for getting an overview or focusing on specific sections.

createFolders.title: Create Folders
createFolders.description: Create new bookmark folders directly from the popup. Keep your bookmarks organized without opening the bookmark manager.

deleteItems.title: Delete Items
deleteItems.description: Remove unwanted bookmarks and folders from the popup or the bookmarks manager. A confirmation dialog is on by default and can be turned off in Settings, and every deletion can be undone for 10 seconds.

maintenanceTools.title: Maintenance Tools
maintenanceTools.description: Clean duplicate bookmarks, remove tracking parameters, scan dead links and review repairs (delete, use the redirect target, use an archived copy, or edit the URL), fetch page titles, inspect privacy-sensitive URLs, and collect bookmark statistics.

importExport.title: Import/Export
importExport.description: Export bookmarks as HTML, JSON, Markdown, or CSV. Import HTML or JSON bookmark files after a preview that shows the target folder, counts, and duplicates, with undo afterward.

aiTools.title: AI Tools
aiTools.description: Use opt-in AI providers for bookmark recommendations, LLM context packing, tag suggestions, summaries, and folder reorganization plans.

contextMenu.title: Context Menu Save
contextMenu.description: Save links from the browser right-click menu into recent folders or the default Bookmarks Bar.

settingsSync.title: Settings Sync
settingsSync.description: Store extension preferences through chrome.storage.sync so settings can follow your browser account where supported.

roadmap.title: Current Focus
roadmap.tests: Browser Coverage — Broaden the Firefox tests and make the Edge and Firefox CI jobs required checks
roadmap.storeDistribution: Store Distribution — Submit to the Chrome Web Store, Firefox Add-ons, and Edge Add-ons (listing material is ready)
